context.requirement_text: Second half of ISS-0411/GH#807's fix, atop REQ-214's dispatch-core module. Mirrors REQ-187's own role for TIMER nodes exactly (engine transition + lifecycle wiring, disjoint files from REQ-214's core, same reason REQ-187 was split from REQ-186: "REQ-186 builds a subsystem, this changes the engine's transition and lifecycle paths"). THE STUB THIS CLOSES: lib/letflow/engine/transition.ex's dispatch_node/4 catch-all clause (currently lines 334-339, pending REQ-214's own edits elsewhere in the file, which do not touch this clause) returns {:error, {:node_type_not_yet_implemented, :SERVICE_TASK, node_id}} for every SERVICE_TASK node. This is the last of the 8 Graph.node_type() variants without a real dispatch_node/4 clause. SCOPE: 1. Transition (PURITY, matching REQ-187's own §4 requirement verbatim for TIMER): a token arriving at a :SERVICE_TASK node must NOT dispatch HTTP synchronously inside transition/3. Add dispatch_service_task/4, following dispatch_human_task/3's async-park shape exactly (lib/letflow/engine/transition.ex:387-390): the token is appended to an InstanceState list field (name it in the moduledoc) and transition/3 returns a new pending_event() variant, {:service_task_dispatch_requested, token_id, node_id}, carrying no config and no HTTP detail. 2. Impure activation-time caller: on {:service_task_dispatch_requested, token_id, node_id}, parse the node's config via REQ-056's parse_config_from_node_attributes/1, render its URL template against instance variables (reuse an existing Letflow rendering mechanism, do not invent a new one), and validate the rendered URL via REQ-056's validate_rendered_url/1. An empty-rendered-URL failure routes through build_empty_url_error_attrs/1 into set_instance_error/2. Otherwise, INSERT one row into REQ-214's service_task_dispatches table (attempt_index 0, next_attempt_at = now) in the SAME transaction as the state-transition event append. 3. Re-entry: a new Letflow.Engine.advance_after_service_task_outcome/N function, directly mirroring Letflow.Engine.advance_after_timer_fired/3's own shape -- called BY REQ-214's dispatcher poller when a dispatch row resolves to :advance or :give_up. :advance carries the decoded 2xx body -- merge it via REQ-049's VariableMerge.merge/3 and advance the token off the :SERVICE_TASK node along its outgoing edge, reusing advance_off_completed_node/4's existing algorithm. :give_up calls Letflow.Engine.set_instance_error/2 directly with REQ-214's returned standalone_error_attrs(), in the SAME transaction as the dispatch row's own terminal-status update. 4. Cancellation: Letflow.Engine.cancel_instance/3 must mark any still-pending service_task_dispatches row for that instance as cancelled in the SAME transaction as the instance's own status flip (mirroring REQ-187's cancel_pending_timers/2 call site). 5. Documentation accuracy fix: correct docs/migration/stage-7-simulation-uat-parity.md's REQ-210 REVIEWER sign-off entry, which currently attributes the Meridian quorum/disbursement paths' unreached status to the now-resolved join_counters defect -- the real cause was always this SERVICE_TASK dispatch gap. NOT IN THIS REQUIREMENT: no change to REQ-214's dispatcher/poller internals; no change to REQ-056's already-shipped pure functions; no route or controller file; no change to the real service_catalog (still S6, unbuilt).
acceptance_criteria: a definition containing a SERVICE_TASK node whose route_kind is inline_url, dispatched against a real (test-server) HTTPS endpoint returning a 2xx JSON object, starts an instance whose token reaches that node, parks (no {:error, {:node_type_not_yet_implemented, :SERVICE_TASK, _}}), and is later advanced past the node once REQ-214's dispatcher resolves it -- an end-to-end test replacing what all three of test/letflow/simulation/req206_swiftroute_test.exs, req207_vortex_test.exs, and req208_meridian_test.exs currently elide, per ISS-0411's own description
req208_meridian_test.exs's committee-vote/quorum-2-of-3/disbursement paths (previously unreached, per ISS-0411) are reached and pass end to end
the SERVICE_TASK dispatch row and its state-transition event are written in ONE transaction: a test that forces the event append to fail leaves no service_task_dispatches row behind

a URL template that renders to an empty string is rejected at activation via build_empty_url_error_attrs/1 and routes to Letflow.Engine.set_instance_error/2's ERROR path rather than ever creating a dispatch row

cancelling an instance with a still-pending service_task_dispatches row marks that row cancelled in the same transaction as the instance's own status flip, and REQ-214's dispatcher never dispatches a cancelled row

lib/letflow/engine/transition.ex contains no :httpc/HTTPoison/Req/File call after this change, and its moduledoc names the new pending_event() variant and which InstanceState field carries the parked token

docs/migration/stage-7-simulation-uat-parity.md's REQ-210 REVIEWER sign-off entry no longer attributes the Meridian quorum/disbursement gap to join_counters, and instead correctly names this requirement's own fix
mix test and mix compile --warnings-as-errors both pass with real output quoted
